meta.title: Nonreal: four virtual creators worth following
meta.description: Meet Kai, Mara, Dante and Iris: four virtual AI creators sharing tech, travel, fashion and wellness. Explore their profiles and follow them on Telegram.
meta.ogTitle: Four creators. None of them real.

hero.subtitle: Nonreal is a studio of virtual creators with their own voices, obsessions and daily feeds. Pick one, step into their world, and follow along on Telegram.

kai.bio: Ex-lab nerd turned explainer. Kai breaks down the week in AI into five minutes you can actually use, with no hype and no jargon.
kai.alt: Portrait of Kai Arden, a man in round glasses and a navy hoodie by a bright window

ask.a: Your tasks change, your job adapts. Learn the tool before it learns you.

dante.bio: Milan-by-way-of-Lagos stylist who reads the street before the runway. Dante builds outfits from thrift racks, tailors and strong opinions.
dante.alt: Portrait of Dante Voss, a man in dark sunglasses and a cream overcoat standing at a window above Milan rooftops

ask.a: A well-cut overcoat. Everything else is a supporting actor.

posts.title: The €20 blazer
posts.body: Thrifted, taken in 2cm, and now it looks like a custom suit.

posts.title: 3 colours
posts.body: is the whole wardrobe rule. Cream, ink and one loud thing.

posts.title: Overheard in Brera

iris.bio: Iris designs small daily rituals: breath, light, movement and food that loves you back. Calm that fits into a busy week.
iris.alt: Portrait of Iris Calder, a woman with a blonde bun and white linen blouse against a sage-green backdrop

ask.a: Try 4-6 breathing for two minutes. Longer exhales tell your body it is safe.

posts.title: The 10-minute reset
posts.body: Window open, shoes off, one slow stretch. That is the whole routine.

posts.title: 21 days
posts.body: of a screen-free first hour. My sleep score changed, and so did my coffee.

posts.title: Sunday pot
posts.body: Lentils, lemon and whatever is wilting. Feeds me until Thursday.
